text: dsh-file-reference-everything 是 DeepSeek Harness 的文件引用搜索插件，可用于 Web 等 DSH 配置。它替换工作区专用的文件引用提供器，在用户输入 @ 时搜索工作区和整台机器的路径。支持 Everything 快速检索、跨平台有界扫描索引、模糊匹配、正则查询及目录浏览，并优先排列工作区结果。适合需要从 DSH 对话中快速引用不同目录文件的用户；Windows 可配置 Everything 与 es.exe，其他系统使用内置扫描索引。

dsh-file-reference-everything adds whole-machine file search to DSH. Typing @ searches workspace and machine paths using Everything on Windows or a bounded built-in index elsewhere. It supports fuzzy and regex matching plus directory browsing, and ranks workspace results first.

让文件引用补全能查找整台电脑上的路径。

DSH 的文件选择能不能支持正则筛选？
想从绝对路径逐层浏览文件和目录。
需要搜索结果优先显示当前工作区里的文件。
Windows 上如何用 Everything 加快文件引用搜索？
没有 Everything 时也想继续搜索本机文件。

dsh-file-reference-everything 的整盘搜索：用户在文件引用查询中输入普通关键词时，插件合并工作区索引与整盘结果；Windows 可调用 Everything，其他情况使用有界扫描索引。
dsh-file-reference-everything 的模糊与正则匹配：在 @ 查询中输入部分名称可按路径评分，使用 re: 或 regex: 前缀可按正则筛选候选路径。
dsh-file-reference-everything 的路径浏览：在 @ 后输入相对目录、绝对目录或 ~/ 路径并逐层浏览，返回匹配的文件和子目录。
dsh-file-reference-everything 的工作区优先排序：普通查询同时获取工作区与整盘候选，并给工作区结果加分后合并去重。
dsh-file-reference-everything 的跨平台回退索引：Everything 不可用时按配置根目录进行有界扫描，索引过期后在后续查询时重建。

dsh-file-reference-everything README · `dsh-file-reference-everything`：Whole-disk implementation of `ctx.fileReferences` for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It upgrades the dialog's `@` file completion from "current workspace" to "any file on the machine": when [Everything](https://www.voidtools.com/) is running, bare queries are answered in milliseconds through the `es.exe` command-line client; otherwise the plugin falls back to its own bounded whole-disk index. The fallback index works on macOS and Linux too, so the plugin is cross-platform. Workspace results are always merged in and ranked ahead of whole-disk hits.

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Requirements：Best experience — all three on Windows:

- [Everything](https://www.voidtools.com/) installed and running.
- [es.exe](https://www.voidtools.com/support/everything/command_line_interface/) discoverable: on `PATH`, in a common install location (official installer, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Everything`, chocolatey, scoop), or pointed at by the `esPath` config key.
- Windows (Everything indexes NTFS in real time).

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Requirements：Without any of these the plugin still works: it detects the missing backend automatically and serves whole-disk queries from its built-in bounded scan index instead.

Note on installing the dsh CLI itself: prefer pnpm (e.g. `pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`, or `pnpm add @deepseek-ai/dsh` in a dedicated directory). In real installs, npm/npx stalls for a long time (>10 minutes) resolving this package's large peer-dependency set.

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Installation：Install from GitHub into the `web` profile (recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lumose0/dsh-file-reference-everything
```

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Installation：dsh's Web UI is its own profile (`dsh web` ≡ `dsh --profile web`), and the `@` file completion UI lives only there; the official `file-reference-local` row also exists only in the web profile. Installing into another profile works too, but `--dump-config` then prints the expected warning `patch: entry "file-reference-local" not found` — harmless; the plugin's own row is inserted regardless.

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Installation：A git install fetches sources, not built artifacts; this package ships a `prepare` script that builds `lib/` from source at install time. pnpm ≥ 10 refuses to run that script until you allow it — the first `add` fails and prints the package key to copy into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-file-reference-everything: true
```

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Installation：then re-run the `add`. That allowance is permission to execute this package's code on your machine at install time, so review the source and pin a commit (`github:lumose0/dsh-file-reference-everything#<sha>`) so a later push cannot silently change what runs. Once the package is published to npm, `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-file-reference-everything` installs prebuilt code and needs no build allowance.

dsh-file-reference-everything README · How it takes effect：The package is a dsh bundle: its `cordis.patch.yml` layer disables the official workspace-only provider row (`id: file-reference-local`, the same row id the `dsh-web-app` bundle inserts) and inserts this plugin's row in its place. If the profile has no such row (a non-web profile), the disable patch warns and is skipped, and this provider still mounts. Verify the composed layers without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

dsh-file-reference-everything README · How it takes effect：The output should contain a `# == dsh-file-reference-everything` layer with the `file-reference-everything` row inserted; in the web profile the official `file-reference-local` row shows `disabled: true`.
dsh-file-reference-everything README · Query syntax：Everything after `@` (or `@"` for paths containing spaces) is the query. Outside regex mode, `\` counts as `/`.

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Query syntax：| Query | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `@config` (bare text) | Fuzzy search over the workspace index merged with the whole-disk backend; workspace hits rank first. |
| `@re:pattern` / `@regex:pattern` | Regular-expression match, workspace and whole-disk. |
| `@D:/...`, `@//server/share/...`, `@/usr/...`, `@~/...` | Browse that absolute directory (`~` expands to the home directory). |
| `@src/comp` (relative path containing `/`) | Browse relative to the agent cwd, same as the official provider. |

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Query syntax：When Everything answers, bare queries pass through as Everything native syntax: space means AND, wildcards and the rest of the [Everything search syntax](https://www.voidtools.com/support/everything/searching/) work as-is.

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Contract |
|---|---:|---|
| `maxResults` | `20` | Maximum ranked candidates returned for one query. |
| `workspaceMaxEntries` | `10000` | Maximum indexed files and directories per agent workspace. |
| `globalMaxEntries` | `200000` | Maximum indexed files and directories in the whole-disk fallback index. |
| `excludedDirectories` | `[".git", "node_modules", "$Recycle.Bin", "System Volume Information", "Windows", "Program Files", "Program Files (x86)", "ProgramData", "AppData", ".cache", ".npm", ".pnpm-store", "Library", "proc", "sys", "dev"]` | Directory basenames never traversed or offered by the fallback index. |
| `roots` | `[]` | Whole-disk scan roots; empty selects automatic detection — every existing drive letter on Windows, the home directory elsewhere. |
| `esPath` | unset | Explicit `es.exe` path; unset enables automatic detection (`PATH`, then common install locations). |
| `everythingTimeoutMs` | `2000` | Timeout in milliseconds for one `es.exe` invocation; a timeout falls back to the built-in index. |
| `refreshSeconds` | `600` | Seconds the whole-disk fallback index stays fresh before the next query

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Configuration：Override the row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (applied after every bundle layer):

```yaml
- id: file-reference-everything
  name: dsh-file-reference-everything
  config:
    maxResults: 30

A patch replaces the row's entire `config` value rather than deep-merging keys, so restate every non-default key you want; keys you omit take the schema defaults above.

dsh-file-reference-everything README · What the model sees：When the addressed agent has an effective `read` tool, the provider contributes the same stable system-prompt section as the official provider:

```markdown
Paths prefixed with @ are files explicitly referenced by the user. Use the read tool when their contents are needed; do not claim to have inspected a file before reading it.
```

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Token effect：Conditional and fixed: the one sentence is present while `read` is visible to the addressed agent; candidate lookup itself adds no tokens, and a selected path contributes only its ordinary user-message characters.

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Known limitations：- **A selected path is a text reference only.** Reading its contents still requires the model to call the `read` tool, subject to the deployment's filesystem namespace and permissions — a whole-disk path may be visible in completion yet unreadable by the tool.
- **The fallback index is bounded and lazy.** Paths beyond `globalMaxEntries` are omitted, the index rebuilds only when a query arrives after `refreshSeconds`, and it has no ignore-file semantics — only `excludedDirectories` basenames are skipped.
- **`es.exe` option collision.** A query starting with `-` may be parsed by `es.exe` as an option instead of a search term.
- **Non-ASCII `where.exe` output.** When `where.exe` cannot report the `es.exe` path reliably (non-ASCII paths under some console code pages), detection falls back to probing the static install locations.
- **Possible duplicate entries.** The same file can appear twice: once as a workspace-relative candidate and once as a whole-disk absolute candidate.
- **Fixed score for Everything-only syntax.** Results the plugin's own scorer cannot match (for example wildcard hits) keep a fixed low score instead of a

dsh-file-reference-everything README · Development：Do not verify the RPC path with `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <local directory>`: a directory install uses a pnpm `link:`, so Node resolves dependencies by realpath from the dev directory's own `node_modules` and loads a private copy of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-file-reference`. The host's Typert gateway then cannot discover the `fileReferences/list` remote method across the mismatched module instances — completion goes silently empty. Verify against the packed artifact instead: `npm pack`, then `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-file-reference-everything-<version>.tgz` (or install via `github:`); peer dependencies then resolve to the host's instances and the path works out of the box.
